minimum_behavior.query_once: one command transmission at most; a timeout or ambiguous result is not retried
minimum_behavior.read_continuation_only: may continue reading an already transmitted response, but must never resend the command
minimum_behavior.safe_to_replay: the caller explicitly opts in; the transport never infers safety from command text
minimum_behavior.consuming_reads: read-to-clear registers and acquisition-bound *OPC? use no_replay
minimum_behavior.partial_response: record partial-response telemetry and return a non-replayable failure
minimum_behavior.backends: PyVISA, RsInstrument, Serial, GuardedAuditedTransport, and FakeTransport share the same contract

acceptance: a failed no_replay query sends at most one command
an allowed continuation read never sends a second command
*OPC? can be marked no_replay for acquisition synchronization
read-to-clear errors cannot be silently replayed
transport telemetry records replay policy and uncertain response state

transitions.preflight_rejection: no I/O and session remains healthy
transitions.readback_failure: uncertain, then poisoned if restoration cannot prove state
transitions.restore_success: healthy with actual quantized values recorded
transitions.close: closed; only a new session can become healthy
